text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): after a PlanReview attempt failed with a repairable PROVIDER_NATIVE_OUTPUT_INVALID, the engine wrote a provider-automatic-retry-schedule (state dispatch-issued) and a prepared replacement invocation, and the job showed runtimeStatus scheduled / status queued, but nothing executed it: `job retry-pump --limit 5` reported due 0 processed 0, and the worker only started when the author ran `propose <change> --resume` with a plan-review-progress envelope rebound to the replacement invocationId and requestDigest (the previous envelope fails with PROPOSE_INPUT_STALE). The schedule should either run the replacement itself or the resume output should say that the resume is what dispatches it.
